1.4 There are infinitely many reflections: by part (4) of [[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]], $st$ has infinite order in $W$. Put $r:=st$; since $sr^{-1}=sts=rs$, induction gives $sr^{-m}=r^{m}s$ and hence $r^{m}sr^{-m}=r^{2m}s$ for every $m\in\mathbb Z$. Each $r^{2m}s$ lies in the reflection set $T=\{wsw^{-1}:w\in W,\ s\in S\}$ ([[def-cg-canonical-reflection-homomorphism]] (2)), and the elements $r^{2m}s$, $m\in\mathbb Z$, are pairwise distinct: if $r^{2m}s=r^{2m'}s$ then right multiplication by $s$ gives $r^{2m}=r^{2m'}$, hence $r^{2(m-m')}=1$ and $m=m'$ because $r$ has infinite order. So $W$ has infinitely many reflections. [given, algebra]

**Given:** A finite Coxeter matrix $(S,m)$, the presented group $W$ with its length $\ell$, the reflection set $T$ and the right action of $W$ on $\{\pm1\}\times T$ of [[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]], and a word $(s_1,\dots,s_k)$ in $S$ in each claim below.

[F2] [[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]]: the right action of $W$ on $\{\pm1\}\times T$ defined by $U_s(\varepsilon,r)=(\varepsilon(-1)^{\delta(s,r)},srs)$ satisfies $(\varepsilon,r)\cdot w=(\varepsilon\,\eta(r,w),w^{-1}rw)$ with $\eta(r,w)=(-1)^{n(r)}$ depending only on $w$ and $r$; $T=\{wsw^{-1}:w\in W,\ s\in S\}$; for a reduced expression $w=s_1\cdots s_k$ with prefix reflections $r_i=s_1\cdots s_{i-1}s_is_{i-1}\cdots s_1$ one has $n(r)\in\{0,1\}$ for every $r$, the map $i\mapsto r_i$ is injective, and $\Phi(w):=\{r_1,\dots,r_k\}=\{r\in T:\eta(r,w)=-1\}$ is independent of the reduced expression, with $\#\Phi(w)=\ell(w)$; also $\ell(s)=1$ for every $s\in S$.

Let $(S,m)$ be a finite Coxeter matrix; let $W$ and $\ell$ be the presented group and its length and let $\sigma:W\to\mathrm{GL}_K(E)$ be the geometric representation, as in [[def-hh-coxeter-matrix-word-group-and-length]], [[def-hh-geometric-coxeter-representation-and-roots]] and [[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]], with reflection set $T$ and sign-change sets $\Phi(w)$ as in that lemma; and let $s\ne t$ in $S$ with $m:=m(s,t)$.

[F3] [[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]]: the assignment $s\mapsto\sigma_s$ induces a homomorphism $\sigma:W\to\mathrm{GL}_K(E)$; $st$ has order exactly $m(s,t)$ in $W$ (infinite when $m(s,t)=\infty$); the right action satisfies $(\varepsilon,r)\cdot w=(\varepsilon\eta(r,w),w^{-1}rw)$ with $\eta(r,w)$ depending only on $w$ and $r$; for a reduced word with prefix reflections $r_i=s_1\cdots s_{i-1}s_is_{i-1}\cdots s_1$ one has $n(r)\in\{0,1\}$ for all $r$ and $\Phi(w)=\{r_1,\dots,r_k\}=\{r:\eta(r,w)=-1\}$ independent of the reduced expression, of cardinality $\ell(w)$; the prefix reflections of the alternating word $(a,b,a,b,\dots)$ with $a=s_1,b=s_2$ are $r_i=(ab)^{i-1}a$; and an alternating word of length $q\le m$, or of any length when $m=\infty$, is reduced in $W$, its value having length $q$.

Let $W=\langle s,t\mid s^2=t^2=1\rangle$ be the infinite dihedral Coxeter group, so $S=\{s,t\}$ and $m(s,t)=\infty$ ([[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]] (3)(c), [[thm-cg-weak-order-meet-semilattice-and-finite-lattice]] (4)). Then:

[L1] For $m(s,t)=\infty$ the rank-two product $st$ has infinite order in $W$, the elements $s,t\in W$ are distinct involutions, and every alternating word $s\,t\,s\,t\cdots$ of length $q\ge1$ is reduced and the values of distinct alternating words are pairwise distinct ([[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]] (3)(c),(4),(7), [[def-hh-coxeter-matrix-word-group-and-length]]).

[F3] Alternating dihedral words are reduced in the ambient group: if $s\ne t$ and $w_q$ is the value of the alternating word of length $q$ beginning with $s$, then $\ell(w_q)=q$ whenever $q\le m(s,t)$ with $m(s,t)<\infty$. ([[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]])
[F3] Alternating dihedral words are reduced in the ambient group: for $q\le m$ the alternating word of length $q$ has length exactly $q$ in $W$. ([[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]])

[F5] There is a homomorphism $\operatorname{sgn}:W\to\{\pm1\}$ with $\operatorname{sgn}(s)=-1$ and $\operatorname{sgn}(w)=(-1)^{\ell(w)}$ for all $w\in W$; hence $\ell(ws)=\ell(w)\pm1$ for all $w\in W$ and $s\in S$. Also $\ell(s)=1$ for every $s\in S$, so $s\ne1$ in $W$. Distinct generators are distinct in $W$, the product $st$ has order exactly $m(s,t)$ in $W$, the standard parabolic subgroup $W_{s,t}$ is the Coxeter system presented by the restricted matrix on $\{s,t\}$ with intrinsic length $\ell_{s,t}$ equal to $\ell$ on $W_{s,t}$, and every left coset $W_{s,t}a$ has a unique minimal-length representative $d$, characterized by $\ell(s'd)>\ell(d)$ for $s'\in\{s,t\}$ and satisfying $\ell(ud)=\ell(u)+\ell(d)$ for all $u\in W_{s,t}$ ([[def-hh-coxeter-matrix-word-group-and-length]], [[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]], [[thm-hh-coxeter-exchange-deletion-and-faithfulness]], [[thm-hh-parabolic-minimal-representatives-and-length-additivity]]).

[F6] For $s\ne t$ and $q\ge1$, if $m(s,t)<\infty$ and $q\le m(s,t)$, or if $m(s,t)=\infty$, then the alternating word of length $q$ beginning with $s$ has length $q$ in $W_{s,t}$ ([[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]]); the same holds for the alternating word beginning with $t$.

[F4] The reflection set carries the right action $(\varepsilon,r)\cdot s=U_s(\varepsilon,r)=(\varepsilon\cdot(-1)^{\delta(s,r)},\,srs)$ of $W$ on $\{\pm1\}\times T$, and $(\varepsilon,r)\cdot w=(\varepsilon\,\eta(r,w),\,w^{-1}rw)$ for a well-defined sign $\eta(r,w)\in\{\pm1\}$ depending only on $w$ and $r$; for a reduced word with prefix reflections $r_i$ one has $n(r)\in\{0,1\}$, the map $i\mapsto r_i$ is injective, and $\Phi(w):=\{r_1,\dots,r_k\}=\{r\in T:\eta(r,w)=-1\}$ is independent of the reduced expression and has cardinality $\ell(w)$ ([[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]]).

[F2] $W$ is presented by $(S,m)$, with universal property and length $\ell$; the alternating words $s\,t\,s\cdots$ of every length are reduced because $m(s,t)=\infty$, so $\ell(s)=1$, $\ell(st)=2$ and $\ell(sts)=3$ ([[def-hh-coxeter-matrix-word-group-and-length]], [[lem-hh-dihedral-root-recurrence-and-root-sign]]).
